purpose: Part 1/2 of verified hard-tail 17-record item effect batch 016; together these files contain exactly 17 self-contained reviewed records.

items/amulet-of-the-silver-tongue.name: Amulet Of The Silver Tongue
items/amulet-of-the-silver-tongue.effectSummary: While worn, the lesser amulet grants a +5 enhancement bonus on Truespeak checks and the greater version grants +10. The item functions for any wearer, but only a creature with the Truespeak skill benefits from the bonus.

items/candle-invocation-265.name: Candle of Invocation
items/candle-invocation-265.effectSummary: Burning a candle creates a 30-foot aura in which creatures matching its alignment gain +2 morale on attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks. A matching cleric who burns it during or just before spell preparation is treated as two levels higher for spells per day while it burns; alternatively, the owner can consume the candle immediately to cast gate for a respondent of the candle's alignment. Otherwise it burns for 4 hours and can be extinguished and relit.

items/candle-of-sweet-breezes.name: Candle of Sweet Breezes
items/candle-of-sweet-breezes.effectSummary: Lighting the single-use candle as a standard action creates a 60-foot-radius bubble of clean breathable air for 1 hour. After 1 round the area is safe from prior lack of air, airborne diseases, poisons, and scents; creatures in the bubble gain +2 on saves against breath weapons entering it. The flame cannot ignite flammable gas, and previous environmental conditions resume normally when the candle expires.

items/cephalometer.name: Cephalometer (Illithid)
items/cephalometer.effectSummary: When fitted around the head of a willing or subdued creature, the cephalometer can use dominate person and feeblemind (DC 17) once per day each. It can also perform one daily mind probe for up to 10 minutes, telepathically extracting truthful answers from the subject's knowledge; sleeping subjects can attempt DC 17 Will after each question to wake, while mind blank and immunity to mind-affecting effects block the probe.

items/clasp-of-safeguarding.name: Clasp of Safeguarding
items/clasp-of-safeguarding.effectSummary: The clasp must be attached to an exposed magic item and activates automatically when the wearer rolls a natural 1 on a save against an effect capable of harming items. For that triggering effect, none of the wearer's exposed items, magical or mundane, are harmed. The clasp works once and then becomes nonmagical.

items/crown-of-the-death-dragon.name: Crown of the Death Dragon
items/crown-of-the-death-dragon.effectSummary: Once per day, after spending 1 round invoking the death dragon, the wearer gains for 13 rounds +4 enhancement natural armor, +4 deflection AC, and 13 temporary hit points. The wearer is armed when making unarmed attacks and the limbs deal short-sword damage; during the effect the wearer cannot cast spells with somatic, material, or non-divine focus components and can use a standard action for a cone of fear (Will DC 20 partial) or a melee touch inflict critical wounds (Will DC 20 half).

items/dimensional-pocket.name: Dimensional Pocket
items/dimensional-pocket.effectSummary: The pocket adheres invisibly to a surface when placed there and activated by command word, can hold up to 1,000 pounds and 150 cubic feet with a mouth up to 1 foot across, and can be removed only by the command word or the wearer's death. The wearer always knows its location; see invisibility or true seeing reveals it, while targeted dispel magic or antimagic can suppress access to its extradimensional space.

items/dragonslayer-claws.name: Dragonslayer Claws
items/dragonslayer-claws.effectSummary: A creature with claw attacks can wear the resizing claws; a wearer that is neither dragon nor dragonblood gains a persistent negative level while they are worn, and a creature without claw attacks gains no benefit. Up to three times per day, no more than once per round, the wearer can designate a claw attack to deal +1d6 damage, or +3d6 against dragons or dragonblood creatures, in which case the claws also count as magic for overcoming damage reduction.

items/elemental-elixir.name: Elemental Elixir
items/elemental-elixir.effectSummary: Drinking the single-dose elixir transforms the drinker for 30 minutes into an air, earth, fire, or water elemental of the drinker's size, dismissible early as a standard action. The drinker's type and subtype change, physical ability scores become those of the elemental, mental ability scores are retained, and the drinker gains the elemental form's extraordinary and supernatural special attacks and qualities; transforming does not heal damage and death returns the body to its original form.
